verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page lists ISO 27001 among its supported frameworks, and its docs show that adding a framework automatically adds its controls, so ISO 27001 is a documented framework in the product. Nothing shows it is first-class beyond that listing. Missing for 10: current Annex A (2022) control set, Statement of Applicability generation, ISO certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow specific to ISO, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, ISO 27001 is a first-class framework — the current Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability, and certification-audit artifacts are supported, not just mapped

citations.quote: Whether you need SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, or another framework. Oneleet's all-in-one platform simplifies your compliance journey.
Removing a framework also removes unused controls that were automatically added for it.
